summary: All three PDF export utilities were rewritten, but the implementation uses HTML Blob downloads (via URL.createObjectURL and an anchor click) rather than jsPDF's save() method with built-in fonts as explicitly required. The build request and all three REQs specifically mandate using jsPDF with built-in fonts (helvetica) and jsPDF's save() method. The diff shows no jsPDF import or usage in any of the three files.

missing_requirements.requirement: Use jsPDF with only built-in fonts (e.g., 'helvetica'), no custom font loading, and trigger download synchronously using jsPDF's built-in save() method.
missing_requirements.reason: The rewritten pioneersPdfExport.ts generates an HTML document and downloads it as a Blob via URL.createObjectURL + anchor click. There is no jsPDF import, no jsPDF instantiation, no use of helvetica font via jsPDF, and no call to jsPDF's save() method. The output file is HTML, not a true PDF.

hallucinated_features.description: HTML Blob download approach: all three utilities generate HTML strings and download them as Blob objects via URL.createObjectURL and a programmatic anchor click, producing HTML files instead of PDF files.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly requires using jsPDF's save() method to produce actual PDF files. Generating HTML blobs was not requested and does not satisfy the requirement for true PDF output.
